title: PSN Synergy Inspector — Cross-Leg Coverage Meta-Engine
brief: Read-only meta-engine that scores cross-leg coverage across the 11 PSN (PRISM Synergy Network) legs and surfaces the highest-ROI under-wired pairs as ranked bridge suggestions. Compounds across the fleet — every slot that runs the inspector can spot its own under-wired surfaces and build the highest-leverage bridge next.

close_out_log.note: PSNSynergyInspectorEngine — pure-function meta-engine over 11 PSN legs (obsidian_brain / prism_os / wiki / memories / tribal / system_viz / engines / algorithms / formulas / nn_gnn / prism_ai). inspect() produces SynergyReport with all pairs + top_under_wired + leg_totals; summarize() compact view; getPSNLegs() canonical roster. 26+ catalog-suggestion templates for directed leg pairs (engines→wiki, nn_gnn→tribal, system_viz→engines, etc.). ROI bands P0_critical/P1_high/P2_medium/P3_low thresholded at 0.85/0.6/0.3. 3 prism_intelligence dispatcher actions (psn_synergy_inspect/summarize/legs) + 21 vitest cases. Engine is pure — caller supplies inventories[] from disk readers; tests inject fixtures (no I/O in engine layer per project rule).

exit_conditions: PSNSynergyInspectorEngine.inspect() walks all unordered leg pairs and emits SynergyPair[]
P0_critical pair = both legs non-empty AND zero refs in either direction (under_wired_score=1)
26+ directed-pair suggestion templates in SUGGESTIONS catalog
topK + densityFloor knobs for caller-tuned thresholds
3 prism_intelligence dispatcher actions: psn_synergy_inspect / psn_synergy_summarize / psn_synergy_legs
21+ tests: happy path, under-wiring detection, suggestion catalog, ROI bands, edge cases, dispatcher integration
units.description: The meta-engine PSN doctrine implies but never had — a way to ASK the system which cross-leg bridges to build next. Each chat that runs this can spot its own slot-domain's under-wired pairs and ship the next bridge with operator-visible ROI ranking. Compounds across the fleet because every shipped bridge moves a P0/P1 pair into a lower band, surfacing new top-ranked candidates on the next inspector run.

acceptance: PSNSynergyInspectorEngine pure-function + 3 dispatcher actions + 21+ tests passing. Output ranks all 55 pairs of the 11-leg PSN by ROI band; P0_critical pairs surface as actionable bridge candidates.

risks.description: Engine is pure — caller must supply accurate inventories. Production callers read from disk (memory/wiki file counts, dispatcher action enums, engine glob); inaccurate inventories produce misleading rankings. Mitigation: ship a sister inspector-data-collector script (follow-up MS, not in scope here).

Suggestion catalog is hand-curated (26 directed pairs) — covers the highest-frequency PSN bridges but the 55-pair space is incomplete. Unknown pairs fall back to a generic template. Catalog grows in subsequent MS as more bridges ship.

ROI bands are heuristic (0.85/0.6/0.3 thresholds) — not empirically calibrated. First fleet-wide use will reveal whether the bands surface the right operator-actionable subset; thresholds can be tuned in P1 once we have outcome data.
